Recorded claim:
`renderMarkdown` supplies `.meta-board-detail-description-rendered`. In `appendList`, consume following non-block lines into the same `<li>`, join them with spaces, and send the result through `appendInlineMarkdown`; otherwise they become paragraphs outside the list. Browser proof was equal wrapped-line left coordinates and computed `23.2px` line height at 16px. [Task 2]
